title: Watch Live: Apple Announces New Products at NYC Event
text:
- Technology Watch Live: Apple Announces New Products at NYC Event UPI Top Stories 10:20 (EST) Apple ( AAPL ) will announce a new lineup of products Tuesday morning, including new versions of the iPad, MacBook, Apple Pencil and iMacs.
The Apple Special Event will begin at 10 a.m. EDT .
Exactly what Apple will unveil from Brooklyn is unknown, but here are some things to watch for:
The new iPAD Pro could be the highlight of the event. Rumors suggest it could borrow from the iPhone X design and have curved corners and rely entirely on Face ID -- with no Touch ID sensor.
The new iPad could also introduce a new magnetic connector for smart keyboards and accessories, and switch to a USB-C charger. If that happens, experts predict Apple will launch a new Apple Pencil that can also charge using USB-C.
The new Pencil could perform more gestures and have improved sensitivity, accuracy and latency.
A thinner and lighter MacBook could replace both the 12- and 13-inch versions of the MacBook Air . Rumors suggest it will have Intel processors, Touch ID and either a T2 or T3 chip. It could also have a Retina display and use a USB-C charger.
Apple also could release some details on a new multi-device wireless charging pad, called AirPower, and new AirPods.
Ahead of Tuesday's event, Apple's online store was taken offline Tuesday, as expected, so it can relaunch after the event with the new products.
